Ok...first a little back story. I am a nervous and socially inept nerdy male and rather recently a college student. Because of a variety of circumstances, I haven't had any real friends in the area for most of my life. I have just started making some friends/acquaintances recently but have experienced some set backs. Like today.

There is one girl who is a class mate who had been friendly with me before. We would greet eachother in passing and stop to chat for a while but that was about it. Sometimes I would feel like I was following her around but honestly it is just coincidental since we would start and end class at around the same time and be heading the same general direction. Admittedly, when somebody is willing to talk to me, I do cling around them a little more than I should - that is mostly just an artifact of being friendless for so many years. Today was about the same. She actually left class a little before I did but I met up with her again in the cafeteria/student meeting area. For some stupid reason I decided it would be a good idea to apologize for being so "clingy". I know - very cringy.

It was most likely completely unnecessary and already set up the feeling that I was kind of "creepy". It would have been bad enough on its own but it got worse.

A few minutes later, I was walking around outside on the campus but mostly walking along the buildings under the eaves because it was raining outside and I didn't have an umbrella or anything. I happened to look in one of the windows and there she was; and she saw me. I could tell from her face that she was starting may have been a bit uncomfortable. I didn't even know she was in that building and I was not looking for her or anyone else. It was really completely coincidental but combined with the stupid thing I said, it was a one-two punch for making me look like I am stalking. That said, I can understand how it would look creepy to be walking along the building wall and peek in the window. After she noticed me, I quickly walked away from embarrassment.

Now I am sitting here feeling depressed that my social challenges failed me again. Sitting in the same classroom with her tomorrow isn't going to be easy. I am sure she is going to avoid me now that I gave off the totally wrong impression.

TL;DR Accidentally followed around a female acquaintance and made her uncomfortable. Now I have an uncomfortable day tomorrow
